reasoning_traces.think:
We formulate assist counts as Poisson-distributed events conditional on opponent field goals. Raw ratios suffer from severe heteroskedasticity and finite-sample bias. Our beta-adjustment projects observed counts onto a shared latent scale, stabilizing variance and correcting systematic under/over-counting by individual scorekeepers. This addresses the 'Van Exel Effect' by neutralizing scorekeeper-specific noise, yielding fairer comparative metrics across seasons and venues.
